title: Canonical tenant join + batch-token-rounding fix for cross-deploy metering drift
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Several customers (two enterprise Dedicated tenants and three Private clusters) reported multi-region / multi-deploy billing deltas over the prior two billing cycles. Symptoms: (1) sustained undercounting on Private clusters after KMS rotation windows, (2) occasional duplicated token credits following proxy failover, and (3) reconciliation job showing orphaned usage rows that don’t join to canonical tenant IDs. Scope crosses Hosted, Dedicated, and Private ingestion paths. This ticket coordinates immediate triage, hotfix rollout, and postmortem for long-term remediation.
steps_to_reproduce: Simulate tenant alias creation by running tenant-migration tool with alias header set; emit usage from private cluster with rotated KMS key
Replay batched requests with microbatch sizes (2-8 reqs) where quantization path forces fractional token rounding
Trigger proxy failover in dedicated pool with in-flight streaming response and retry logic enabled
Run reconciler job against the daily usage export and inspect rows with null canonical_tenant_id
investigation_notes: 03/02: Pager received from SRE: multiple customers flagged variance >5k tokens/day
03/03: Initial triage found reconciler left-join using tenant_alias column introduced in 2025 migration; new alias key naming (alias_v2) not included in join conditions
03/04: Private deploys during KMS rotation created ephemeral session tokens that lost X-Forwarded-Tenant header; ingestion created a fallback placeholder tenant 'unknown-org'

03/05: Metering microbatch rounding path (quantize_tokens()) drops fractional tokens per-request instead of aggregating batch and rounding at window boundary leading to systemic undercounting (~0.2% per-batch, amplified by small batch sizes)
03/06: Retry dedup observed duplicate token emission when idempotency-key was not propagated through the proxy on failover; found missing header mapping in edge-proxy v2.7 config

03/07: Cross-check of ledger dump shows orphaned usage rows (tenant_alias=alias_v2) that did not map to canonical tenant in customer directory due to missing alias mapping file in private cluster bootstrap

03/08: Reconciler hotfix branch created to include alias_v2 in join; separate metering patch created to move rounding to window-level aggregation and to add integrity checks; patch for proxy header mapping prepared
action_items: Hotfix A: Update daily_reconciler SQL to coalesce(alias_v2, tenant_alias, legacy_tenant_id) as canonical_tenant_id and backfill missing mappings (PR #1482)
Hotfix B: Deploy metering patch that aggregates token fractions across batch window and applies banker's rounding at emission point (PR #1484)
Hotfix C: Patch edge-proxy config to persist idempotency and tenant headers across reconnects (PR #1487)
Deploy plan: Canary reconcile change to staging exports -> run diff job -> if diff < 0.01% promote to prod; deploy metering change to Hosted then Dedicated canary then Private (staggered)
Customer comms: Draft runbook and notify affected accounts with timeline and temporary credit offer pending reconciliation results
Monitoring: Add dashboard tiles for reconciler join misses, per-tenant unmatched-usage-rate, and microbatch rounding delta; add alert if unmatched >0.05%

2026-03-05 Aisha Patel (PM): Notifying three affected accounts (AcmeCorp, FinEdge, Medlytics) with ETA for hotfix. Offering provisional credit for March invoices; finance looped in.

2026-03-07 Security review (J. Nguyen): No sensitive data exposure in reconciler join change. Confirmed change is a join/transform only. Security sign-off granted.
2026-03-08 Miguel Santos: Canary reconcile run completed against staging export; unmatched rate dropped from 0.43% to 0.004%. Proceeding to prod rollout at 03:30 UTC with one-hour monitoring window.

acceptance_criteria: Daily reconciler unmatched-rate <= 0.01% across all regions for 7 consecutive days
Per-tenant monthly delta reduction to within 1% of expected usage for all affected customers
No new duplicate token emissions observed in end-to-end test harness for failover scenarios
Customer confirmations received for AcmeCorp, FinEdge, Medlytics and finance sign-off on credit adjustments
resolution_summary: Deployed reconciler join fix to include alias_v2 and backfilled canonical_tenant_id mappings for affected rows. Metering microbatch rounding logic moved aggregation to window boundary and applied consistent rounding; edge-proxy header mapping fixed to persist idempotency and tenant headers across reconnect. Initial post-deploy reconciliation reduced unmatched rate from 0.43% to 0.004%. Customer credits processed and customers acknowledged resolution. Remaining task: rollout metering patch to Dedicated and remaining Private clusters, postmortem and long-term observability improvements.
